title: fzf's key bindings on the packaged fish, which claim keys in every bind mode
notes: Two things are recorded rather than driven on this shell here. A takeover while the reader waits for the rest of a key sequence: the reader this corpus leaves in that wait has moved by the time the fence behind the cancellation is asked, so what is measured is a different reader. And its numeric argument, which its vi bindings accumulate: the keys that reach it here ended the reader rather than leaving it holding a count. The package suite drives both.

plugin.probe: echo kr-plugin=(functions -q fzf-file-widget; and echo on; or echo off)
